description: Moves a server to a new IPv4 address: it is snapshotted and recreated in the same city with the same disk contents, and the old address is released for good. Takes several minutes of downtime. Sets a new random root password, returned once (it stays in the chat history). Needs confirm: true and the server's exact label; without both it only describes what would happen.

confirm.description: true changes the IP; without it the tool only describes what would happen.

label.description: The server's exact label, as a second check.

name: change_ip
title: Get a new IPv4 address
